settings.title: The Science of KDF-55 Filtration
settings.description: Hard water minerals, chlorine, and heavy metals accumulate in your pipes and flow directly onto your skin every day. Vellano's proprietary KDF-55 media neutralises these threats at the molecular level.

settings.title: Clinically proven. Dermatologist recommended.
settings.description: Independent laboratory testing confirms a 98% reduction in chlorine and a 95% reduction in heavy metals after a single pass through the Vellano filter cartridge.
